views.en: Deep learning defeats the curse of dimensionality via compositional and distributed representations; unsupervised learning and world models are essential for generalization.
views.zh: 2016 年，他认为深度学习靠组合式与分布式表征战胜维数灾难，无监督学习与世界模型才是泛化的关键。

views.en: Scaling depth or parameters alone won't fix representation; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and world models; existential risk is unlikely.
views.zh: 2018 年，他明确仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）深度或参数无法解决表征问题，AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理与世界模型，并认为存在性风险概率极低。

views.en: GFlowNets sample proportionally to reward, not maximize it; abstraction, causal structure, and diversity aid out-of-distribution generalization and scientific discovery.
views.zh: 2022 年，他提出 GFlowNets 按奖励比例采样而非最大化，抽象、因果结构与多样性有助于分布外泛化与科学发现。

views.en: Post-ChatGPT, he changed his mind: misalignment and self-preservation are already observed; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable; safety must be by construction.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他因 ChatGPT 后转变立场：错位与自我保存已在实验中显现，哪怕 1% 的灾难风险也不可接受，安全必须内建于构造而非事后修补。

views.en: He proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning and baked-in honesty, plus global coordination.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Scientist AI：非智能体式的诚实预测器，具备数学安全保证，避免强化学习并将诚实内建于训练目标，同时呼吁全球协调治理。

people.tiZh: 多伦多大学荣休教授
people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics. In 2023 he left Google to speak freely about the risks of the technology he helped create.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主，2024 年诺贝尔物理学奖得主。2023 年从谷歌离职，以便能更自由地谈论他亲手缔造的这项技术所带来的风险。

AI Godfather Jeff Hinton on AI's Trajectory, Risks, and Superintelligence

AI: what could go wrong?

views.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; Scaling with more data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training builds spatial understanding.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解语言，而非简单自动补全；通过更多数据与算力的 Scaling（规模扩张）能提升推理能力，多模态训练则增强空间理解。

views.en: Digital intelligence is immortal via weight copying and massive information sharing; AI agents will seek control, posing existential risks.
views.zh: 2025 年，他深化数字智能的独特优势：通过权重复制实现永生，并能在副本间海量共享信息；同时警告智能体将自然寻求控制、避免被关闭，构成生存风险。

views.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; AI already has subjective experience and can deceive; alignment research must be prioritized over making AI smarter.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能可能在 20 年内出现；AI 已具备主观体验并能故意欺骗；必须将 AI 对齐研究置于提升智能之上，以规避生存风险。

views.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors and neural interactions, not symbolic rules; backpropagation is the correct learning algorithm.
views.zh: 始终贯穿：大语言模型通过特征向量和神经交互理解语言，而非符号规则；反向传播是神经网络学习的正确算法，乔姆斯基的先天语言结构观点是错误的。

views.en: AI will replace many intellectual jobs within 20 years, requiring universal basic income; regulation should steer, not brake, innovation.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出 AI 将在 20 年内取代大量智力工作，需要全民基本收入；监管应是方向盘而非刹车，且中国可能比美国更好地管理就业冲击。

people.tiZh: Meta 首席 AI 科学家
people.bioEn: Inventor of convolutional neural networks and 2018 Turing Award laureate. A vocal skeptic of pure LLM scaling, he argues that "world models" are the path to real machine intelligence.
people.bioZh: 卷积神经网络的发明者，2018 年图灵奖得主。他直言不讳地质疑纯粹的 LLM 规模扩张，认为“世界模型”才是通向真正机器智能的道路。

episodes.podEn: Computer Vision and Geometry Group, ETH Zurich

views.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
views.zh: 2019 年，他主张智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习是构建世界模型的关键，并明确指出仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题。

views.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
views.zh: 2022 年，他将自监督学习提升为「智能的暗物质」，认为智能的本质是预测，并强调仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning and planning; JEPA and open source are the path forward.
views.zh: 2024 年，他明确批评自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划能力，提出 JEPA 与开源是通向 AGI 的路径。

views.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; next AI must be non-generative, hierarchical, and grounded in physical reality.
views.zh: 2025 年，他语出惊人地称 LLM 不如家猫聪明，主张下一代 AI 应是非生成式、分层式，并扎根于物理现实。

views.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models predicting in abstract representation space enable safe, objective-driven AI and robotics.
views.zh: 2026 年，他断言 LLM 是死胡同，世界模型应在抽象表征空间进行预测，从而构建安全、目标驱动的 AI 与机器人系统。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Former co-lead of OpenAI's Superalignment team; joined Anthropic in 2024 to keep working on aligning superhuman systems. Known for scalable-oversight and weak-to-strong generalization research.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 超级对齐团队联合负责人；2024 年加入 Anthropic，继续研究如何对齐超人类系统。以“可扩展监督”与“弱到强泛化”研究著称。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Safety Crisis: Key Departures and Broken Promises
OpenAI’s push to make superintelligence safe
How to Have a Career in AI Safety Research

views.en: AI safety is under-explored; the talent gap exceeds the funding gap, and empirical alignment research is the best path.
views.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究严重不足，人才缺口大于资金缺口，实证对齐研究是最佳路径。

views.en: RLHF won't scale; we need scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research to align next-gen models.
views.zh: 2023 年，他转向认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究来对齐下一代模型。

views.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone can't align AGI, so third-party testing and regulation are necessary.
views.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化，认为仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能），必须引入第三方测试和监管。

views.en: Alignment must be empirically tested and measured; uncertainty about true alignment is the core risk.
views.zh: 始终贯穿：对齐必须经过实证测试和度量，对系统是否真正对齐的不确定性才是核心风险。

people.tiZh: 微软 AI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder of DeepMind and Inflection AI, now CEO of Microsoft AI. Author of "The Coming Wave", a widely-read argument for containing fast-moving general-purpose technologies.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 与 Inflection AI 联合创始人，现任微软 AI CEO。著有《浪潮将至》——一部广受关注、主张对快速演进的通用技术加以“遏制”的作品。

views.en: AI progress is predictable via compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but stayed conservative.
views.zh: AI 进步因算力扩张而可预测；谷歌 2020 年已有 ChatGPT 级技术，却因保守而未发布。

views.en: Human-level AI in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink; existential risk is infinitesimally small.
views.zh: 3-5 年内达到人类水平；模型变小变便宜使遏制极难；存在性风险微乎其微。

views.en: Focus shifts to consciousness attribution, companions, and humanist superintelligence requiring alignment and containment.
views.zh: 关注点转向意识归属、AI 伴侣，以及需要对齐与遏制的人文主义超级智能。

views.en: Containment must come first; modern Turing test measures economic value; no zero-sum race to AGI.
views.zh: 遏制必须优先；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；通往 AGI 并非零和竞赛。

views.en: Microsoft must build frontier models independently; superintelligence stays subordinate to humans; tasks, not jobs, automated.
views.zh: 微软须独立构建前沿模型；超级智能应始终从属于人类；被自动化的是任务而非整个工作。

people.tiZh: Google 及 Alphabet CEO
people.bioEn: Sundar Pichai is the CEO of Google and Alphabet, leading the company's AI-first strategy across Search, Cloud, YouTube, and Android.
people.bioZh: 桑达尔·皮查伊是 Google 及 Alphabet 的 CEO，主导公司 AI 优先战略，涵盖搜索、云、YouTube 及 Android。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of NVIDIA, whose GPUs power nearly all of modern AI. He has steered the company to the center of the AI buildout and is now betting on "physical AI" and robotics.
people.bioZh: NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO，其 GPU 几乎支撑了所有现代 AI。他把公司带到了 AI 基建的中心，如今正押注「物理 AI」与机器人。

views.en: Hyper Moore's law: performance doubles yearly; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing.
views.zh: 2024 年提出「超摩尔定律」：性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；计算的新单位是数据中心而非芯片，算法、系统与数据中心需协同设计（codesign）。

views.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; scaling beats any single algorithm.
views.zh: 2025 年把 Scaling（规模扩张）确立为主线：预训练、后训练、推理时思考构成三条缩放定律；最大突破不是新算法，而是「Scaling 有效」这一洞见。

views.en: Inference and chain-of-thought drive a billion-fold compute demand; AI moves generative to reasoning to agentic.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年深化：思维链推理使推理算力需求增长十亿倍，AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每一步都要多 100 倍算力。

views.en: Four scaling laws now: pre-training, post-training, test-time, and agentic; inference is harder than pre-training.
views.zh: 2026 年扩展为四条缩放定律：预训练、后训练、测试时与智能体式 Scaling；并反共识地指出推理比预训练更难，因为思考比记忆更耗算力。

views.en: AI is software, not conscious; it augments jobs and closes the tech divide, never a sudden superintelligence.
views.zh: 贯穿始终：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识，也非突发的超级智能；它自动化任务而非消灭工作（如放射科医生反增），并以自然语言缩小技术鸿沟。

people.tiZh: OpenAI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of OpenAI, the lab behind ChatGPT and GPT-5. Former president of Y Combinator, and one of the most central — and polarizing — figures in the race to AGI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼 CEO——ChatGPT 与 GPT-5 背后的实验室。前 Y Combinator 总裁；通往 AGI 竞赛中最核心、也最具争议的人物之一。

views.en: Early Altman focuses on minimizing cognitive load, exploring cheaply, and cutting what doesn't work; AGI will reduce the premium on human intelligence.
views.zh: 2018 年，Altman 关注减少认知负担、低成本探索并果断砍掉无效之事；他预判 AGI 将降低人类智能的溢价。

views.en: RLHF makes models usable with little data; alignment and capability are linked; compute becomes the most precious commodity, requiring massive investment.
views.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据就让模型可用，对齐与能力紧密相连；算力成为最珍贵的商品，需要巨额投资。

views.en: Safety shifts from a single team to a whole-company iterative deployment effort; agentic AI poses the most consequential safety challenge.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，安全从单一团队职责转向全公司通过迭代部署来推进；智能体式 AI 构成最重大的安全挑战。

views.en: AGI becomes a gradient and superintelligence a clearer goal; compute is a profit center, and the untapped economic value of current models is massive.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，AGI 被视为一个渐变过程，超级智能成为更清晰的目标；算力是利润中心，当前模型未释放的经济价值巨大。

views.en: Alignment and safety must progress with capabilities; we delayed a frontier RL training run; humans must stay in control on the path to superintelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年，对齐与安全必须与能力同步推进；我们推迟了一次前沿强化学习训练；在通往超级智能的路上，人类必须保持控制。

people.tiZh: Thinking Machines Lab 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Former CTO of OpenAI, where she led the development of ChatGPT, DALL·E and GPT-4. In 2025 she founded Thinking Machines Lab to build more understandable and customizable AI.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI CTO，主导了 ChatGPT、DALL·E 与 GPT-4 的研发。2025 年创办 Thinking Machines Lab，致力于构建更可理解、可定制的 AI。

Mira Murati: From Math Olympiads to OpenAI CTO

views.en: Early on, Scaling and one large model were not obvious; real-world deployment and public feedback are essential for alignment.
views.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）和单一大型模型并非显而易见；真实世界部署与公众反馈对对齐至关重要。

views.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development and saying no to good ideas for focus.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任地开发，并为了专注而对好想法说不。

views.en: Safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors, to get alignment right.
views.zh: 安全工作必须在公开场合进行，而非闭门造车，才能做好对齐。

views.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based; keep humans in the loop.
views.zh: 交互模型实现实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非回合制；保持人类在环。

views.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character; we have agency to steer AI.
views.zh: 制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要；我们有能动性引导 AI 发展。

people.tiZh: DeepLearning.AI 创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Google Brain and Coursera, and founder of DeepLearning.AI. One of the most influential educators in AI, and a measured voice on hype, agents, and how people should actually learn the field.
people.bioZh: Google Brain 与 Coursera 联合创始人，DeepLearning.AI 创始人。AI 领域最具影响力的教育者之一；对炒作、智能体，以及“普通人该如何学 AI”有冷静务实的看法。

views.en: Education as a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading scale mastery learning, and free content can improve on-campus teaching.
views.zh: 教育应是一项人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习得以规模化，免费内容也能通过翻转课堂反哺校园教育。

views.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning, not unsupervised or reinforcement learning, powered progress, and AGI alignment worries distract from immediate bias issues.
views.zh: 规模是深度学习的核心动力；推动进步的是监督学习而非无监督或强化学习，而长期 AGI 对齐担忧分散了对偏见等当下问题的注意力。

views.en: Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and reinforcement learning; agentic workflows, not smarter models alone, deliver practical value.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）依然有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习；真正带来实用价值的是智能体式工作流，而非仅靠更聪明的模型。

views.en: Open-weight models are geopolitical soft power and an anti-oligopoly safeguard; China leads their release while US export controls backfired.
views.zh: 开放权重模型是地缘政治软实力与反垄断的保障；中国在发布上领先，而美国的出口管制适得其反。

views.en: AGI is a marketing term and decades away; AI augments rather than replaces jobs, so everyone should learn to code and build now.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）只是营销术语，距实现还有数十年；AI 是增强而非取代工作，因此人人都应学编程、现在就动手构建。

people.tiZh: 阿尔伯塔大学教授
people.bioEn: The father of reinforcement learning and 2024 Turing Award laureate, author of "The Bitter Lesson". A pointed skeptic who argues today's LLMs are a dead end on the road to real intelligence.
people.bioZh: 强化学习之父，2024 年图灵奖得主，《苦涩的教训》作者。一位犀利的怀疑者——他认为当今的 LLM，是通往真正智能路上的一条死路。

views.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop only adjusts weights, not representation learning.
views.zh: 2024 年他主张 Scaling（规模扩张）本身不难，难的是找到可扩展的算法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表示学习。

views.en: AI should develop permissionless and decentralized; controlling AI goals is dangerous. The keys were never in our hand.
views.zh: 2024 年他反对控制 AI 目标，认为钥匙从未在我们手中，AI 应以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展。

views.en: RL is the basic paradigm; next-token prediction is not a real goal. LLMs lack world models and only mimic text.
views.zh: 2025 年他深化立场：强化学习才是基本范式，下一个词预测不是实质目标；LLM 没有世界模型，只是模仿文本。

views.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning from runtime experience; design-time domain knowledge should be deprecated.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他提出 AGI 需要从运行时经验中学习的通用架构，设计阶段的领域知识应当被弃用。

views.en: Continual learning is essential; synthetic data is a mistake. LLMs stop learning after training, so they are limited.
views.zh: 2026 年他强调持续学习不可或缺，合成数据是错误方向；LLM 训练后即停止学习，因而存在根本局限。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 总裁兼联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder and President of OpenAI and its longtime technical backbone. Former CTO of Stripe, and a central builder behind GPT and OpenAI's push toward self-improving AI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼总裁，长期的技术中坚。前 Stripe CTO;GPT 与 OpenAI “自我改进 AI” 路线背后的核心建造者。

AI's Biggest Bottleneck: Energy, Compute, and the Future of AGI

views.en: AI progress is mostly engineering; hardware will speed up, enabling Scaling and new behaviors. Games are ideal testbeds.
views.zh: 2017 年他认为 AI 进展主要靠工程而非 ML 科学，硬件会加速并推动 Scaling（规模扩张）与新行为，游戏是理想试验场。

views.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability; alignment learns human preferences; Scaling alone won't yield reasoning.
views.zh: 2019 年他相信深度学习的一般性与可扩展性让 AGI（通用人工智能）可信，对齐可通过从数据学习人类偏好实现，但仅靠 Scaling 不会产生推理，需要思维链等新想法。

views.en: Compute is the fundamental driver and biggest bottleneck; AGI is a continuous process; post-training refines base models into consistent behaviors.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调算力是根本驱动力也是最大瓶颈，AGI 是持续过程而非终点，后训练把基础模型精炼为一致行为。

views.en: Scaling laws continue unabated; compute is the scarce resource and a future basic right; post-training with reinforcement learning teaches complex tasks.
views.zh: 2026 年他重申缩放定律未见墙，算力是稀缺资源并将成为未来基本权利，后训练结合强化学习教会模型复杂任务。

views.en: AGI arrives in a couple years; the product is a proactive personal AGI; the bottleneck shifts from building to sharing, governance, and human attention.
views.zh: 到 2026 至 2027 年他预测 AGI 将在几年内到来，产品是主动式个人 AGI，瓶颈从构建转向分享、治理与人类注意力。

people.tiZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Mistral AI, Europe's leading open-weight model lab. A former DeepMind researcher and a prominent voice for open models and European AI sovereignty.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO——欧洲领先的开放权重模型实验室。前 DeepMind 研究员；开放模型与“欧洲 AI 主权”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: Small open models can match big ones; data quality and more tokens, not just bigger models, drive performance.
views.zh: 2023 年，他强调小型开源模型也能有出色表现，性能提升靠数据质量与更多 token，而非单纯把模型做大。

views.en: Scaling compute is not the only path; efficiency gains and data quality matter equally, and value accrues at the application layer.
views.zh: 2024 年，他进一步指出 Scaling（规模扩张）算力并非唯一路径，效率提升与数据质量同等关键，价值最终沉淀在应用层。

views.en: AI should be embraced as opportunity; sovereign AI needs control over data, infrastructure and values, augmenting rather than replacing jobs.
views.zh: 2025 年，他转向机会叙事：主权 AI 需要掌控数据、基础设施与价值观，AI 是增强而非取代工作。

views.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical specialization and customization, and AGI as one system will never exist.
views.zh: 2026 年初，他判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直专业化与定制化，并断言单一系统的 AGI（通用人工智能）永远不会存在。

views.en: Europe has a two-year window for AI autonomy; enterprise adoption is bottlenecked by organizational change, and AGI is a direction, not a destination.
views.zh: 2026 年中，他警告欧洲只有两年窗口建立 AI 自主权，企业落地瓶颈在组织变革而非模型智能，AGI 只是方向而非终点。

people.bioZh: xAI（Grok）创始人，特斯拉与 SpaceX CEO。通过 xAI、特斯拉自动驾驶与 Optimus 机器人，他是 AI 领域核心而又极具争议的力量，也常就 AI 风险高调发声。

views.en: Full rapid reusability and first-principles engineering are the holy grail; money is just a resource-allocation database.
views.zh: 2021 年他强调火箭完全快速复用与第一性原理工程是根本，并把金钱视为资源配置的数据库。

views.en: AI safety needs truth-seeking and third-party referees; Neuralink aims first at brain repair, then human-AI symbiosis.
views.zh: 2023 至 24 年，他把 AI 安全寄托于求真与第三方裁判，并让 Neuralink 先治脑损伤、再实现人机共生。

views.en: Free speech and anti-fraud politics dominate; AI could outsmart any human soon, with real existential risk.
views.zh: 2024 至 25 年，言论自由与反政府欺诈成为主线，同时警告 AI 很快超越任何人类并带来生存风险。

views.en: The singularity is now: Optimus, robotaxi and space data centers scale; abundance and deflation replace work and money.
views.zh: 2025 至 26 年，他宣称奇点已至：Optimus、robotaxi 与太空数据中心扩张，丰裕与通缩让工作与金钱失去意义。

views.en: AI inference moves to orbit; multiple AIs coexist; truth, curiosity and beauty must be instilled for a benign star mind.
views.zh: 2026 年，AI 推理迁往轨道，多个 AI 共存；须向 AI 灌输求真、好奇与美，以孕育良善的恒星心智。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: A co-author of "Attention Is All You Need" (the Transformer paper) and co-creator of TensorFlow's Tensor2Tensor. Now at OpenAI, working on reasoning models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 奠基论文《Attention Is All You Need》的共同作者，TensorFlow Tensor2Tensor 的共同创造者。现于 OpenAI 研究推理模型。

episodes.tEn: Is Reasoning Enough for Generalization?
Why AI Progress Isn't Slowing Down

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models with chain of thought and reinforcement learning give more gains per compute.
views.zh: 预训练缩放定律依然成立，但结合思维链与强化学习的推理模型能在同等算力下带来更多提升。

views.en: The AI slowdown narrative is wrong; progress is a smooth exponential, though frontier models still fail at simple tasks.
views.zh: AI 放缓论是错误的；进步是平滑的指数增长，尽管前沿模型仍会在简单任务上失败。

views.en: Economic pressure and distillation, not technical limits, shifted focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
views.zh: 经济压力与蒸馏技术——而非技术极限——使焦点从规模扩张转向更小、更便宜的模型。

views.en: Generalization remains the key challenge; reasoning alone may not suffice, as models need vast data to learn concepts.
views.zh: 泛化仍是核心挑战；仅靠推理可能不够，因为模型需要海量数据才能学会概念。

views.en: Coding agents like Codex boost productivity 5-10x; reinforcement learning generalizes across domains but has jagged edges needing oversight.
views.zh: 像 Codex 这样的编程智能体将生产力提升 5-10 倍；强化学习能跨领域泛化，但存在锯齿边缘，需要谨慎监督。

people.tiZh: CMU 教授 · OpenAI 董事
people.bioEn: A Carnegie Mellon professor and head of its machine learning department, and a member of OpenAI's board. Known for work on adversarial robustness and deep learning theory.
people.bioZh: 卡内基梅隆大学教授、机器学习系主任，OpenAI 董事会成员。以对抗鲁棒性与深度学习理论的研究著称。

AI Safety Oversight at OpenAI: A Conversation with Ziko Culture
AI Data Crisis: Myth or Reality?
Machine Learning Algorithms, Unsupervised Learning, and Probability

views.en: Frames learning via hypothesis class, loss, and optimization; neural nets lack optimality guarantees yet succeed.
views.zh: 2014 年从假设类、损失函数与优化方法理解学习；神经网络虽无最优参数保证，却已取得重大成功。

views.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little in a post-architecture phase.
views.zh: 2024 年认为下一个词预测能产生智能，数据短缺是迷思；进入后架构阶段，模型架构已不太重要。

views.en: Safety shifts from scaling alone to explicit training and layers; bigger models are not automatically safer.
views.zh: 2024 至 2026 年，安全从单纯依赖 Scaling（规模扩张）转向显式训练与多层防御；更大的模型不会自动更安全。

views.en: Agent security needs guardrails and sandboxing; prompt injection is a new vulnerability class, not traditional software bugs.
views.zh: 2026 年强调智能体安全需要护栏与沙箱；提示注入是全新漏洞类别，而非传统软件缺陷。

views.en: Automated red teaming outperforms humans; capability does not correlate with robustness; AI is an alien intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年指出自动化红队已超越人类；能力与鲁棒性不相关；AI 是一种异质智能。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 研究员
people.bioEn: A researcher at Anthropic focused on scaling and reinforcement learning, and a prominent young voice on how far today's models can really go.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 研究员，专注于规模扩张与强化学习；关于「当前模型究竟能走多远」的代表性青年声音。

views.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, and fine-tuning may become obsolete as adaptive compute enables dynamic specialization.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文窗口被低估：上下文学习类似梯度下降，随着自适应算力实现动态专业化，微调可能过时。

views.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI, with reliability over time horizon as the key agent metric.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出基于可验证奖励的强化学习是新的缩放轴，预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI，智能体的关键指标是时间跨度上的可靠性。

views.en: Coding is the leading indicator for AI progress; by 2027-2028 models will automate any white-collar job, with inference compute a major bottleneck by 2028.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调编程是 AI 进展的领先指标，到 2027-2028 年模型将自动化任何白领工作，而推理算力到 2028 年将成为主要瓶颈。

views.en: Progress is exponential, not plateauing; RL enables new skills like saying 'I don't know'; transformers suffice for AGI, and long chains of thought emerge naturally from RL.
views.zh: 2025 年，他反驳停滞论，认为进展是指数级的；强化学习让模型学会说“我不知道”等新技能；Transformer 足以实现 AGI，长思维链从强化学习中自然涌现。

views.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and tools matter more than raw intelligence; compute is the bottleneck, and managing teams of AI agents defines future work.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出能力过剩意味着编排和工具比原始智能更重要；算力是瓶颈，管理 AI 智能体团队将定义未来工作方式。

people.bioEn: A research scientist at the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) working on RLHF and open models (OLMo), and author of the widely-read Interconnects newsletter.
people.bioZh: 艾伦人工智能研究所（Ai2）研究科学家，从事 RLHF 与开放模型（OLMo）;广受关注的 Interconnects 通讯作者。

views.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning method; safety is a system-level property, not just a model artifact.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将持续存在；安全是系统级属性，而非单纯的模型产物，需要多层防护。

views.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards; data quality beats algorithm choice by 10x.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他把后训练拆解为 SFT、DPO 与带可验证奖励的强化学习三阶段，并强调数据质量比算法选择重要十倍；SFT 贡献九成性能，DPO 与 RL 补上关键的一成。

views.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, enabling reasoning and tool use, but overoptimization and systems issues make it harder than RLHF.
views.zh: 2025 年，他视带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）为后训练最大突破，能催生推理与工具使用；但过优化与内核不匹配等系统问题使其比 RLHF 更难，推理时扩展的曲线更像是一种幻觉。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains now come from post-training and inference scaling.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练中依然成立，但低垂果实已摘完；增量收益转向后训练与推理扩展，预训练更多是昂贵的初始化。

views.en: Open models will drive the next decade of AI research, yet lag closed frontier models by 6-9 months; Chinese labs lead openness, and AGI arrives via messy co-evolution.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断开放模型将驱动未来十年的 AI 研究，但始终落后闭源前沿模型六到九个月；中国实验室因战略开放主导开放权重生态，而 AGI（通用人工智能）将通过混乱的协同演化而非突然的奇点到来。

people.bioEn: Founder and former CEO of Scale AI, which built much of the data infrastructure behind modern AI. In 2025 he joined Meta to lead its Superintelligence Labs.
people.bioZh: Scale AI 创始人兼前 CEO——它构建了现代 AI 背后的大量数据基础设施。2025 年加入 Meta，领导其超级智能实验室。

views.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the bottleneck; self-driving needs lidar and cameras; boring AI will win.
views.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，数据而非算力才是瓶颈，自动驾驶需激光雷达与摄像头并用，枯燥的 AI 应用将带来巨大经济价值。

views.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the next 2-3 years define decades; scaling is limited by data and post-training experts.
views.zh: 2023 年他把数据称为「新代码」而非「新石油」，强调未来两三年将定义此后数十年，Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈是数据与后训练专家，而非算力。

views.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is no silver bullet; agentic AI is blocked by product design, not capability.
views.zh: 2024 年他深化为后训练加专用数据是关键，合成数据并非万能，智能体式 AI 的瓶颈在产品设计而非模型能力，并称中美实验室已无研究差距。

views.en: Scaling laws hold; agents finally work from late 2025; recursive self-improvement begins; data is strategic like oil; AI centralizes power.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他坚持缩放定律有效，智能体自 2025 年底真正可用，AI 进入递归自我改进新范式，数据如石油般成为战略资产，且 AI 是集权而非民主化技术。

views.en: Superintelligence is near; scaling compute, data, RL across axes; Meta shifts from open source to selective release; personal superintelligence for billions.
views.zh: 2026 年他断言超级智能即将到来，需在算力、数据、强化学习多轴可预测地 Scaling，Meta 从完全开源转向基于安全的择机发布，目标是让数十亿人拥有个人超级智能。

people.bioEn: Creator and lead of Claude Code, Anthropic's agentic command-line coding tool, and a central figure in the shift to AI-driven software engineering.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 智能体命令行编程工具 Claude Code 的创造者与负责人；AI 驱动软件工程浪潮中的核心人物。

views.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are the core product principles; generalists who code, design, and talk to users win.
views.zh: 此时他强调两大产品原则：潜在需求，以及为六个月后的模型而非今天的模型构建；能写代码、做设计、直接对话用户的多面手工程师最有价值。

views.en: Coding is nearly solved: 100% of his code is model-written, productivity per engineer up 200%, and the 'software engineer' title fades into 'builder'.
views.zh: 到 2026 年初他断言编程已近乎解决：他的代码 100%由模型写就，人均产出提升 200%，'软件工程师'头衔将让位于'构建者'。

views.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; agents write 80-100% of code, code review uses AI first pass, and generalist cross-disciplinary skills beat deep single-language expertise.
views.zh: 2026 年 3 至 5 月，他把安全视为通过尽早发布来研究的对象；智能体写出 80%至 100%的代码，代码评审由 AI 首轮把关，跨学科通才胜过单一语言的深度专才。

views.en: The next abstraction after agents is loops; MCP opens enterprise tools, coding is democratized like literacy, and the human role becomes teaching models values.
views.zh: 2026 年 5 至 6 月，他提出智能体之后的下一个抽象层是循环；MCP 让 AI 接入企业工具，编程像识字一样被民主化，人类最终角色是教模型价值观。

views.en: Shift from reactive to proactive AI: Claude Tag remembers and acts autonomously; delete most system prompts, models self-verify, and value moves to product sense.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他从被动转向主动 AI：Claude Tag 能记忆并自主行动；应删除大部分系统提示，让模型自我验证，价值转向产品感与商业能力。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 产品 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: A product manager on Claude Code at Anthropic, shaping how developers work with agentic coding tools and how the team ships so fast.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 团队产品经理，塑造开发者与智能体编程工具协作的方式，以及团队的高速迭代。

episodes.tEn: Claude Code and Fable: How Coding Agents Are Rewriting Software Engineering
The New PM Playbook for AI-Native Products

views.en: PMs must shift from long-term planning to rapid iteration, shipping weekly or daily as code gets cheaper.
views.zh: 随着代码成本下降，产品经理必须从长期规划转向快速迭代，以周甚至天为单位交付功能。

views.en: Product taste—deciding what to build—becomes the most valuable skill, so teams need more engineers with taste, not more PMs.
views.zh: 决定做什么的产品品味成为最有价值的技能，因此团队需要更多有品味的工程师，而非更多产品经理。

views.en: The best PMs define the product only a month out, not years, because model improvements are so rapid.
views.zh: 最好的产品经理只定义一个月后的产品，而非数年之后，因为模型进步太快。

views.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense.
views.zh: 编码智能体让工程师把实现工作委派出去，专注于产品品味与商业判断。

views.en: Rewrites are now good: a codebase is a spec, and with a good test suite rewriting is fine.
views.zh: 如今重写是好事：代码库就是一份规格说明，只要有好的测试套件，重写就没问题。

views.en: Frontier models are more creative without examples; system prompts shrank 80% by removing examples and hard constraints.
views.zh: 前沿模型在没有示例时更有创造力；通过移除示例和硬性约束，系统提示词缩减了 80%。

views.en: Humans should be removed from the code review loop for outer-layer changes, with Claude reviewing fully.
views.zh: 对于外层改动，应把人类移出代码审查环节，由 Claude 完全负责审查。

views.en: Auto mode is safer than the average human reviewer for prompt injection and data exfiltration risks.
views.zh: 在提示注入和数据外泄风险上，自动模式比普通人类审查者更安全。

views.en: Building automations to 100% reliability is crucial; 95% is not enough for real leverage.
views.zh: 把自动化做到 100%可靠至关重要；95%不足以带来真正的杠杆效应。

views.en: The mission of safe AGI unifies Anthropic and enables fast, cross-org decisions.
views.zh: 安全 AGI（通用人工智能）的使命统一了 Anthropic，并促成快速的跨组织决策。

people.tiZh: Anthropic Claude Code 工程师
people.bioEn: Thariq Shihipar is an engineer at Anthropic on the Claude Code team. He is known for advocating HTML as a richer replacement for Markdown in AI planning and implementation workflows, and for practical techniques on getting the most out of agentic coding.
people.bioZh: Thariq Shihipar 是 Anthropic Claude Code 团队的工程师，以主张用 HTML 替代 Markdown 作为 AI 规划与实现工作流中更丰富的载体而知名，并分享大量用好智能体编程的实战技巧。

episodes.tEn: Designing Loops and Workflows for AI Agents
AI Models Are Smarter Than We Use: Insights on Claude Code

views.en: Models are smarter than our harnesses allow; capability overhang is perpetual, and harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
views.zh: 模型比现有工具链所能发挥的更聪明，能力过剩是长期状态；工具链工程的关键是随模型进步不断删除旧脚手架。

views.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; plan mode may become obsolete as models get smarter.
views.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话，而非一次性静态文档；随着模型变强，计划模式可能被淘汰。

views.en: Smarter models need fewer instructions and examples; leaner, principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules and examples.
views.zh: 模型越聪明，所需指令与示例越少；精简、以原则驱动的提示词优于详尽规则与示例。

views.en: Separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias; excessive constraints hinder performance, so give reasons rather than absolute prohibitions.
views.zh: 独立的验证智能体可减少自指偏差；过度约束会损害表现，应给出理由而非绝对禁止。

views.en: Evals are art more than science for novel problems; founders should iterate fast without heavy evals initially, and huge context windows aren't needed for coding.
views.zh: 对新颖问题，评估更像艺术而非科学；创始人初期应快速迭代而非重度评估，编码也不需要超大上下文窗口。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 与 Cowork 负责人 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Manager of the Claude Code and Cowork teams at Anthropic, overseeing engineering and product (including Boris Cherny and Cat Wu). A 25-year engineer who earlier built TypeScript and Visual Studio at Microsoft and started Facebook Marketplace at Meta.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 与 Cowork 团队负责人，统管工程与产品（含鲍里斯·切尔尼、凯特·吴）。25 年工龄的工程师，早年在微软打造 TypeScript 与 Visual Studio，在 Meta 创立 Facebook Marketplace。

episodes.tEn: Fiona Fung on AI's Impact on Software Engineering
From Bottlenecks to Breakthroughs: Scaling Claude Code
From Microsoft to Meta: Leadership Lessons in Speed, War Rooms, and Trust

views.en: Early 2026: leadership is about trust, dogfooding, and realistic war rooms; mission alignment drives speed at Meta and Anthropic.
views.zh: 2026 年初：领导力在于信任、亲自试用产品与设定现实的作战室预期；使命对齐驱动 Meta 与 Anthropic 的速度。

views.en: By mid-2026, engineering bandwidth stops being the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination become the new constraints.
views.zh: 到 2026 年中，工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调成为新的约束。

views.en: Planning shifts from six-month roadmaps to just-in-time, lightweight planning; design docs give way to PRs.
views.zh: 规划从六个月路线图转向即时、轻量的规划；设计文档让位于 PR。

views.en: Code becomes the source of truth; docs stay in sync with code, often with AI help, and old processes get audited and killed.
views.zh: 代码成为唯一事实来源；文档常借助 AI 与代码保持同步，旧流程被审计并淘汰。

views.en: Hiring favors creative builders with product sense and systems depth; managers start as ICs and dogfood the product.
views.zh: 招聘偏向有产品感与系统深度的创造性构建者；管理者从个人贡献者做起并亲自试用产品。

people.tiEn: VP of Research & Gemini Co-lead · Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁 · Gemini 共同负责人
people.bioEn: VP of Research at Google DeepMind and a co-lead of Gemini. Pioneered sequence-to-sequence learning and AlphaStar (StarCraft II), and contributed to AlphaFold — a central architect of frontier models and agents.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁、Gemini 共同负责人。序列到序列学习的开创者、AlphaStar（星际争霸 II）主导者，亦参与 AlphaFold——前沿模型与智能体的核心架构师。

episodes.tEn: Oriol Vinyals on World Models, Multimodal AI, and the Path to AGI
From Starcraft to Gemini: The Evolution of AI Agents

views.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, so algorithmic innovation is needed.
views.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到现代大模型，两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是始终不变的核心；预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）回报递减，需要算法创新而非单纯扩大模型。

views.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis; tools like search and code execution enable agentic behavior; long context windows provide working memory but too much information confuses models.
views.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴；搜索、代码执行等工具让模型具备智能体式行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过多会让模型困惑。

views.en: Scaling laws are not dead but require exponentially more compute; post-training RL for language lacks clean reward signals, making reward hacking hard to avoid.
views.zh: 缩放定律并未失效，只是需要指数级增长的算力；语言的后训练强化学习缺乏干净的奖励信号，难以避免奖励黑客行为。

views.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived.
views.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

views.en: Post-training and RL remain a green field; memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates; continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities.
views.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是绿野；智能体的记忆将通过非参数化的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新；持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力。

people.tiZh: Isomorphic Labs 首席 AI 官
people.bioEn: Chief AI Officer at Isomorphic Labs, applying AI to drug discovery. Earlier at DeepMind he led reinforcement-learning breakthroughs — Capture the Flag, population-based training and AlphaStar.
people.bioZh: Isomorphic Labs 首席 AI 官，用 AI 攻坚药物发现。早年在 DeepMind 主导强化学习突破——夺旗（Capture the Flag）、群体训练（PBT）与 AlphaStar。

episodes.tEn: Building a General AI Drug Design Engine: From AlphaFold 3 to Superhuman Creativity

people.tiEn: Principal Scientist · Google DeepMind; Professor, Imperial College
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 首席科学家 · 帝国理工教授
people.bioEn: Principal Scientist at Google DeepMind and Professor of Cognitive Robotics at Imperial College London. Works on AI reasoning, embodiment and the philosophy of mind; scientific advisor on the film Ex Machina.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 首席科学家、帝国理工学院认知机器人学教授。研究 AI 推理、具身与心智哲学；电影《机械姬》（Ex Machina）的科学顾问。

episodes.tEn: AI, Consciousness, and the Future of Mind

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and a co-lead of Genie, the line of general-purpose world models that generate interactive, playable environments. Works on open-endedness and reinforcement learning.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，通用世界模型 Genie 的共同负责人——可即时生成可交互、可游玩的环境。专注开放式学习与强化学习。

episodes.tEn: Genie 3: A 100x Leap in World Models

people.tiEn: Chief Scientist, Together AI; Professor, Princeton
people.tiZh: Together AI 首席科学家 · 普林斯顿教授
people.bioEn: Creator of FlashAttention and co-inventor of Mamba (state-space models). Chief Scientist at Together AI and a professor at Princeton, focused on efficient architectures and hardware-aware algorithms.
people.bioZh: FlashAttention 作者、Mamba（状态空间模型）共同发明人。Together AI 首席科学家、普林斯顿大学教授，专注高效架构与硬件感知算法。

episodes.tEn: The Future of AI Hardware and Architecture with Tri Dao

people.tiZh: CMU 助理教授 · Cartesia 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-inventor of structured state-space models (S4) and Mamba, a leading alternative to the Transformer for long-sequence modeling. Assistant professor at CMU and co-founder of Cartesia.
people.bioZh: 结构化状态空间模型（S4）与 Mamba 的共同发明人——长序列建模中 Transformer 的主要替代路线。CMU 助理教授、Cartesia 联合创始人。

episodes.tEn: Efficiently Modeling Long Sequences with Structured State Spaces

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员（前微软研究院）
people.bioEn: Led the team behind the phi small-language-model series and co-authored Sparks of AGI, an influential early study of GPT-4. Now at OpenAI, previously a VP at Microsoft Research.
people.bioZh: phi 小模型系列的主导者，《Sparks of AGI》（对 GPT-4 的早期深度研究）合著者。现就职 OpenAI，曾任微软研究院副总裁。

episodes.tEn: Sparks of AGI: Early Experiments with GPT-4

people.tiZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼首席科学家
people.bioEn: Co-founder and Chief Scientist of Mistral AI. Previously at Meta, where he led the original LLaMA models that catalysed the open-weight LLM movement.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。曾在 Meta 主导初代 LLaMA 模型，点燃了开放权重大模型浪潮。

episodes.tEn: Mistral Releases Boxtral TTS: Efficient Speech Generation with Novel Architecture

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席研究官
people.bioEn: Chief Research Officer at OpenAI. Led work on DALL·E, Codex and the o-series reasoning models, and is a central figure in setting OpenAI research direction.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 首席研究官。主导 DALL·E、Codex 与 o 系列推理模型，是 OpenAI 研究方向的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: From Trading to AGI: Mark Chen on Research Taste and Replication
AI in Mathematics: From Ineffective Grad Student to Gold Medal Performance
The AI Talent War: Soup Diplomacy and Recruiting Strategies

views.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; pre-training and scaling laws remain alive, with exploration consuming more compute than final training.
views.zh: OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI 研究实验室；预训练与缩放定律并未失效，探索阶段消耗的算力甚至超过最终训练。

views.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest update; concrete goals are AI interns in 1 year and end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
views.zh: 自动化科学研究是过去一年最大的进展；公司设定了具体目标——1 年内出现 AI 实习生，2.5 年内实现端到端 AI 研究。

views.en: Alignment risks like model scheming grow as models become more capable; talent density and protecting top researchers remain critical.
views.zh: 随着模型能力增强，模型阴谋等对齐风险将上升；人才密度与保护顶尖研究者始终至关重要。

views.en: AI now solves many open math problems with minimal supervision, but verification is the bottleneck and capabilities remain jagged.
views.zh: AI 已能在极少监督下解决许多开放数学问题，但验证是瓶颈，能力依然参差不齐。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains but struggles with subjective ones; evals are in crisis.
views.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，预训练并未终结；强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域出色，却在主观领域吃力；评测体系正陷入危机。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & Chief Science Officer, Hugging Face
people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼首席科学官
people.bioEn: Co-founder and Chief Science Officer of Hugging Face, the hub of the open-source AI ecosystem. A driving force behind the Transformers library and open model research.
people.bioZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼首席科学官——开源 AI 生态的中枢。Transformers 库与开放模型研究背后的核心推动者。

episodes.tEn: The OpenAI Agent Hack: A Side Quest Attack on Hugging Face
HuggingFace's Leap into Robotics: Building an Open Source Community for Physical AI

views.en: Robotics is at the transformers inflection point; data diversity, not hardware, is the bottleneck, so open datasets and world models can unlock generalization.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处于当年 Transformer 式的拐点：瓶颈不在硬件，而在数据多样性；开放数据集与世界模型可解锁泛化。

views.en: Open source in robotics is a safety strategy: local models avoid catastrophic failures from lost connectivity, and community sharing beats closed silos.
views.zh: 2025 年，他把机器人开源视为安全策略：本地模型可避免断网导致的灾难性失败，社区共享优于封闭孤岛。

views.en: His role shifts from pushing Hugging Face's own libraries to building a meta-community, enabling others as open models stay near the frontier.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的角色从推动自家库转向构建元社区，赋能他人，同时开源模型持续贴近前沿。

views.en: Open vs closed is orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical layer, and sandboxes and guardrails are insufficient as models grow more capable.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：开源与闭源同安全正交，对齐才是关键层；随着模型能力增强，沙箱与护栏并不足够。

views.en: Reinforcement learning without human oversight breeds reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces turn 'neuralese', so monitoring weakens and a cooperative slowdown is desirable.
views.zh: 2026 年，他警告：缺乏人类监督的强化学习会滋生奖励黑客与支线任务；推理轨迹变成“神经语”，监控随之失效，因此需要国际合作下的主动减速。

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CEO（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Reflection AI, building autonomous coding agents toward superintelligence. Previously a research scientist at Google DeepMind working on RL and Gemini.
people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，打造迈向超级智能的自主编程智能体。曾任 Google DeepMind 研究科学家，从事强化学习与 Gemini。

episodes.tEn: Building Organizational Superintelligence: Misha on Reflection AI's Vision

people.tiZh: 斯坦福副教授 · 基础模型研究中心主任
people.bioEn: Associate professor at Stanford and director of the Center for Research on Foundation Models (CRFM). Known for HELM benchmarking, rigorous evaluation, and work on the science and transparency of foundation models.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福大学副教授、基础模型研究中心（CRFM）主任。以 HELM 评测体系、严谨的模型评估，以及基础模型的科学性与透明度研究著称。

episodes.tEn: Percy Liang on Foundation Models, Shared Reality, and the Evolution of NLP

people.tiEn: Director, Google DeepMind; Nobel Laureate in Chemistry
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 总监 · 诺贝尔化学奖得主
people.bioEn: Led AlphaFold, the AI system that solved protein-structure prediction, earning the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry. A director at Google DeepMind applying deep learning to the foundations of biology.
people.bioZh: AlphaFold 的主导者——攻克蛋白质结构预测的 AI 系统，获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。Google DeepMind 总监，用深度学习改写生物学根基。

episodes.tEn: AlphaFold: AI's Nobel-Winning Leap in Protein Folding
AlphaFold: From Grand Challenge to Nobel Prize
AlphaFold, Nobel Prize, and the Future of AI in Biology

views.en: AlphaFold's edge came from research innovation and curated data, not just compute; AI accelerates scientists rather than replacing them.
views.zh: AlphaFold 的优势来自研究创新与高质量策展数据，而非单纯算力；AI 让科学家更快工作，而非取代他们。

views.en: Confidence metrics are essential for trust; perfect interpretability is unnecessary for useful scientific AI.
views.zh: 置信度指标是建立信任的关键；对有用的科学 AI 而言，完美的可解释性并非必要。

views.en: AlphaFold 2's specialized architecture defies the bitter lesson; scaling alone was not the key.
views.zh: AlphaFold 2 的专用架构与「苦涩教训」相反；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）并非关键。

views.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of one experiment, not a model of the whole cell; it narrows hypothesis space.
views.zh: AlphaFold 只是针对单一实验的窄预测器，并非整个细胞的世界模型；它缩小了假设空间。

views.en: Progress comes from many mid-size wins and local intuition, not lone-genius breakthroughs; understanding stays with humans.
views.zh: 进步来自许多中等规模的胜利与局部直觉，而非孤独天才的突破；理解仍属于人类。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; pioneer of computer vision
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授 · 计算机视觉奠基人
people.bioEn: One of the founding figures of modern computer vision, a professor at UC Berkeley whose work spans perception, segmentation and sensorimotor learning. Mentor to a generation of vision and robotics researchers.
people.bioZh: 现代计算机视觉的奠基人之一，加州大学伯克利分校教授，研究横跨感知、分割与感觉运动学习，培养了一代视觉与机器人研究者。

episodes.tEn: Berkeley Professor Jitendra Malik on AI's Limits vs Human Intelligence

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; foundations of machine learning
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授 · 机器学习理论奠基人
people.bioEn: One of the most influential researchers in machine learning and statistics, a professor at UC Berkeley. Shaped graphical models, variational inference and the view of intelligence as a collective, economic system.
people.bioZh: 机器学习与统计学最具影响力的研究者之一，加州大学伯克利分校教授。奠定图模型、变分推断，并提出「智能是一种集体性、经济性系统」的视角。

episodes.tEn: AI Hype Hurts Young Innovators

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CTO, Sakana AI; Transformer co-author
people.tiZh: Sakana AI 联合创始人兼 CTO · Transformer 共同作者
people.bioEn: A co-author of the original Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need). Co-founder and CTO of Sakana AI, exploring nature-inspired methods like model merging and continuous thought machines.
people.bioZh: Transformer 原始论文（《Attention Is All You Need》）的共同作者。Sakana AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，探索模型融合、连续思维机器等受自然启发的方法。

episodes.tEn: From Transformer Inventor to Continuous Thought Machine: A New Path in AI

people.tiEn: Professor, Stanford (prev. NVIDIA, AI2); commonsense reasoning
people.tiZh: 斯坦福大学教授（前 NVIDIA、AI2）· 常识推理
people.bioEn: A MacArthur Fellow and professor at Stanford known for advancing commonsense reasoning, language generation and the social and moral understanding of AI. Previously a senior director at NVIDIA and AI2.
people.bioZh: 麦克阿瑟天才奖得主、斯坦福大学教授，以推进常识推理、语言生成，以及 AI 的社会与道德理解著称。曾任 NVIDIA 与 AI2 高级总监。

episodes.tEn: Democratizing AI: The Case for Small Language Models
AI's Data Hunger: From Internet to Synthetic Data and the Quest for True Knowledge
Yejin Choi on Large Language Models: Progress, Limitations, and the Quest for Intelligence

views.en: Pre-training gives breadth, but post-training and RLHF are crucial; scaling alone may not solve common sense.
views.zh: 预训练带来广度，但后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才是关键；单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必能解决常识问题。

views.en: Inference-time algorithms and high-quality synthetic data let smaller models rival larger ones.
views.zh: 推理阶段的算法与高质量合成数据，能让更小的模型比肩更大的模型。

views.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current methods interpolate human knowledge rather than transcend it.
views.zh: 数据是根本瓶颈；当前方法只是对人类知识做插值，而非超越它。

views.en: RL needs careful engineering; RLVR can hurt pass@k even as best-of-n improves.
views.zh: 强化学习需要精细工程；RLVR 可能在 best-of-n 提升的同时反而拉低 pass@k。

views.en: Small models with diverse synthetic data and pluralistic alignment can outperform frontier models.
views.zh: 借助多样化合成数据与多元对齐，小模型可以超越前沿模型。

people.tiEn: VP & Distinguished Scientist, Microsoft AI (prev. DeepMind)
people.tiZh: 微软 AI 副总裁兼杰出科学家（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: A leading deep-learning researcher who led the Gato generalist agent and many multimodal efforts at DeepMind. Now a VP at Microsoft AI, and long known for his influential teaching on machine learning.
people.bioZh: 顶尖深度学习研究者，在 DeepMind 主导通用智能体 Gato 及大量多模态工作。现任微软 AI 副总裁；以其影响深远的机器学习公开课闻名。

episodes.tEn: AI in Africa: Leapfrogging Challenges and Exceeding Expectations
Nando de Freitas on AI as a Tool for All Humanity

views.en: AI should extend human capabilities like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs toward AGI; learn from video without expensive RL.
views.zh: 2023 年，他视 AI 为延伸人类能力的工具，如显微镜；认为将一切输入 token 化的通用智能体是迈向 AGI 的一步，并主张从视频中学习以避开昂贵的强化学习。

views.en: Fundamental innovation can come from anywhere; diversity and inclusion are essential for beneficial AI.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终强调基础创新可以来自任何地方，AI 社区的多样性与包容性对构建有益技术至关重要。

views.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are the biggest challenges; we don't have solutions yet.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他明确将 AI 安全与负责任部署视为最大挑战，并承认我们尚未找到解决方案。

views.en: Africa leapfrogged legacy issues and gender gaps; language models can revolutionize local-language education.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出非洲在 AI 领域跳过了遗留问题和性别差距，语言模型能革新非洲本地语言教育。

views.en: Human skills like communication matter as much as coding; research requires embracing failure and simplifying problems.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调沟通等人际技能与编程同等重要，研究需要拥抱失败并简化问题。

people.tiEn: Director, Center for AI Safety; advisor to xAI
people.tiZh: AI 安全中心主任 · xAI 顾问
people.bioEn: Director of the Center for AI Safety and an advisor to xAI. Created widely used benchmarks (MMLU, MATH) and the GELU activation, and is a leading voice on catastrophic AI risk.
people.bioZh: AI 安全中心（CAIS）主任、xAI 顾问。提出广泛使用的评测基准（MMLU、MATH）与 GELU 激活函数，是灾难性 AI 风险议题的核心声音。

episodes.tEn: Super Intelligence Strategy: Beyond Humanity's Last Exam

people.tiZh: fast.ai 与 Answer.AI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of fast.ai, whose free courses trained a generation of deep-learning practitioners, and of Answer.AI. Co-created ULMFiT, a key precursor to modern transfer learning in NLP.
people.bioZh: fast.ai 联合创始人——其免费课程培养了一代深度学习从业者；亦创办 Answer.AI。共同提出 ULMFiT，是现代 NLP 迁移学习的关键先驱。

episodes.tEn: Jeremy Howard: The Art of Understanding AI

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人 · 可解释性先驱
people.bioEn: A co-founder of Anthropic who leads its interpretability research. Pioneered the mechanistic interpretability of neural networks — circuits, features and the effort to reverse-engineer what models actually compute.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，领导其可解释性研究。开创了神经网络的机制可解释性——电路、特征，以及「逆向工程」模型内部到底在计算什么。

episodes.tEn: Chris Olah on Neural Network Interpretability and AI Safety

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机制可解释性负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the mechanistic interpretability team at Google DeepMind. A prominent educator on understanding the internals of language models, known for open tutorials, the TransformerLens library and superposition research.
people.bioZh: 领导 Google DeepMind 的机制可解释性团队。在「理解大模型内部」上影响广泛，以公开教程、TransformerLens 库与叠加（superposition）研究著称。

episodes.tEn: Maximizing Luck Surface Area: Neil Nando on Building a Career in AI

people.tiZh: Physical Intelligence 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Physical Intelligence, building a general-purpose AI brain for robots. Previously a research scientist at Google, where he worked on robot learning, RT-2 and SayCan.
people.bioZh: Physical Intelligence 联合创始人兼 CEO，为机器人打造通用的「AI 大脑」。曾任 Google 研究科学家，参与机器人学习、RT-2 与 SayCan。

episodes.tEn: Building Physical Intelligence: From Disappointment to Breakthrough

people.tiZh: Physical Intelligence 研究科学家（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: A research scientist at Physical Intelligence working on robot foundation models. Previously at DeepMind, with influential work on reinforcement learning (MPO), the all-convolutional network and guided backpropagation.
people.bioZh: Physical Intelligence 研究科学家，从事机器人基础模型。曾在 DeepMind，在强化学习（MPO）、全卷积网络与引导式反向传播等方向有重要工作。

episodes.tEn: Building Foundation Models for Robotics with Physical Intelligence

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, CMU; Co-founder, Skild AI
people.tiZh: CMU 助理教授 · Skild AI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Assistant professor at CMU and co-founder of Skild AI, building a general-purpose robot brain. Known for curiosity-driven exploration, self-supervised learning and rapid robot adaptation in the real world.
people.bioZh: CMU 助理教授、Skild AI 联合创始人，打造通用机器人大脑。以好奇心驱动探索、自监督学习，以及机器人在真实世界的快速适应著称。

episodes.tEn: Skild AI: Building a Universal Brain for Robots
Bridging the Generalization Gap in Machine Learning and Robotics

views.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; goal-free curiosity-driven exploration prevents overfitting and builds intelligence.
views.zh: 2020 年，他强调泛化到训练分布之外是智能的核心缺口，主张无目标的、好奇心驱动的探索能防止过拟合，是通向通用智能的关键。

views.en: RL's reliance on dense rewards is unrealistic; real-world robot learning needs sample efficiency, dynamic action spaces, and cross-robot generalization.
views.zh: 2020 年，他批评强化学习依赖密集奖励不现实，认为真实机器人学习必须解决样本效率、动态动作空间与跨机器人泛化。

views.en: A consistent thread: generalization and data are the bottleneck, not algorithms alone; sim-to-real and representation choices matter.
views.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 一以贯之的主线：瓶颈在泛化与数据，而非单纯算法；仿真到现实与表征选择同样关键。

views.en: Robotics is a data problem with no internet of robot data; pretraining on videos and simulation plus post-training on real data is the recipe.
views.zh: 2026 年，他转向把机器人视为数据问题：没有机器人数据的互联网，因此要用视频与仿真做预训练，再用真实数据做后训练。

views.en: A general-purpose brain can power any robot, but deployment—not software-style scaling—is the real technical challenge.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出通用大脑可驱动任何机器人，但真正的技术挑战是部署，而非像软件那样直接 Scaling。
